programme.title: Deep in the Realm of Conscience
programme.desc: During the reign of Emperor Shang of Tang, Li Longji and his aunt, Princess Taiping, launch a coup that restores Prince of Xiang, Li Dan to the throne.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when a household is in total meltdown and filled with constant battles? Meet a mother who is afraid of her 17-year-old son and the stepfather who says he's caught in the middle. But is the boy the only one to blame for the chaos in the house?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil's guests say they are ready to run for the hills! Meet Kelly, who calls herself a runaway bride, and Chad, who says weddings are too expensive. Can Dr. Phil get them to commit?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Angie says stepfather Ralph routinely sexually abused her as a teen. Angie says that her stepfather didn't stop with her, he turned his attention, affection & sexual abuse toward her daughter Hannah. They say grandma Leta knew, yet looked the other way.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How did 21-year-old Jenna go from being a straight-A UC Berkeley student and former beauty queen to abusing heroin and meth and used as sexual currency in a drug house? Her mom is desperate to save her only child and turns to Dr. Phil for intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melissa, 26, left home without warning & flew 2,000 miles across the country, leaving behind a note that said, "One day, Dr. Phil will be able to help me." The family says she hadn't "been herself." Melissa says she's ready to tell why she vanished.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trust has been ranked as the #1 crucial quality for a happy marriage. Deanne & Brian have been married for 12 years with four children between them. Now, due to alleged lies and infidelity, their family is torn apart and divorce is just a signature away.

programme.title: Universe
programme.desc: This cinematic masterpiece inspired Stanley Kubrick's "2001: A Space Odyssey." Realistic animation explores distant galaxies beyond the reach of telescopes, immersing viewers in awe-inspiring cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Beautiful Lennard Island
programme.desc: Steven Holland, age ten, is the son of the lighthouse-keeper in charge of Lennard Island, a tiny place west of Vancouver Island. He takes us on a tour and dispels any ideas we might have that living in isolation is boring.

programme.title: If You Love This Planet
programme.desc: This film records a lecture given to students by outspoken nuclear critic, Dr. Helen Caldicott, president of Physicians for Social Responsibility in the United States. Her message is clear: disarmament cannot be postponed.

programme.title: The Town Mouse And The Country Mouse
programme.desc: Evelyn Lambart's animation style shines in this short film adapting an Aesop fable. It contrasts two mice's lifestyles, advocating for simplicity and peace over luxury amid danger.

programme.title: Gurdeep Singh Bains
programme.desc: Gurdeep is a thirteen-year-old Canadian Sikh whose family runs a dairy farm near Chilliwack, British Columbia. They have retained their language and religion. Sometimes he feels a little different from the other children because he wears a turban.

programme.title: Cornet At Night
programme.desc: This film recalls rural life on the Prairies in the 1930s. A farmer's young son, sent to town to hire a man for the harvest, readily accepts when an itinerant trumpet player, down on his luck, begs a chance.

programme.title: Corral
programme.desc: A portrait of a cowboy rounding up wild horses, lassoing one of the high-spirited animals in the corral, and then going for a glorious plunging ride across the visually spectacular Rocky Mountain foothills in Alberta.

programme.title: Patricias Moving Picture
programme.desc: Patricia Garner approached middle age in despair. Sandwiched between changing social values and the loss of her own family role, she was afraid of the future. This film tells of her inspiring struggles and successes.

programme.title: The Story Of Peter And The Potter
programme.desc: When Peter accidentally breaks a glass bowl intended as a birthday gift for his mother, Mr. and Mrs. Deichmann and their daughter Anneke, all artisans in clay, come to the rescue and make him one of their designs while Peter watches.

programme.title: Some American Feminists
programme.desc: A series of interviews, interspersed with newsreel footage, places the American feminist movement in a historical perspective. Six of the women who gave impetus to the movement discuss those issues that most concern them and which are still being debated.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors insight into the world's second-biggest economy, delivering in-depth discussions with newsmakers.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa, linking the market drivers from overnight in the U.S. and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep-dive analysis of the top businesses.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
programme.desc: From London, essential morning viewing to stay ahead of the day's market trends with news stories from the U.S. and Asia in the lead-up to the opening of European markets.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
programme.desc: "The Opening Trade" explores things to know as markets open across Europe; analysis that isn't available anywhere else, a break down of the biggest stories of the day and top guests who have skin in the game.
